alignments.note: Vocative name; the ASV writes no O for it.
Paragogic he on the imperative, no English realization (rule 32).
ASV reads the King as subject of the jussive, matching the Masoretic division.
Jussive rendered with the volitive frame Let ... answer, discontinuous around the subject (rules 17, 25).

בְּיוֹם 'in the day of' rendered by the single word when, which carries both the temporal noun and the relation; the construct noun is left no English of its own, so rule 40's fusion clause and rule 30's one-rendering condition apply and the pair shares one unit headed on the construct noun, as לִפְנֵי → before does (rule 23). The competing reading gives when to the בְּ alone under rule 52 and marks יוֹם unrepresented; rejected because rule 30 forbids one rendered morpheme standing beside an unrepresented partner whose sense the one word carries.
Infinitive construct as rectum keeps the verb (rules 19, 52).
Suffix on the infinitive construct is its subject and takes we (rule 18).

review_notes: Corrected: בְּיוֹם → when is fused as one unit headed on יוֹם rather than leaving the construct noun unrepresented beside a בְּ holding the whole word.
